note: Track singing-intervals, step 1: the major 3rd and the 5th up from Do, first copied (Do and the note both sound), then found from Do alone; the Plays switch is off so each block keeps its job. The key is moves in place of the old Key selector, with a {{?key}} line on what stays the same.

exercise.title: A 3rd and a 5th up from Do
exercise.why: Do, Mi and Sol are the three notes of the home chord, so copying the leaps from Do to Mi and from Do to Sol gives your ear the sound to aim for when only Do plays.

cells.text:
Press Start below: Do sounds, then the note to sing, and the mic starts. The leap shows by name: M3 for a major 3rd, Do up to Mi, and P5 for a 5th, Do up to Sol. Sing the second note back and hold it until Yes shows. Sing it on "oo".
Press Next below for another leap.
Practice until you hear the landing note in your head before it sounds.

Press Start below to hear Do and start the mic. Now only Do sounds. Hear the landing note in your head first, then sing it and hold it until Yes shows. Sing it on "oo".
If a note won't come, press Show me below to hear it.
{{?key}}In another key Do is a new note, and Mi and Sol are still the same leaps above it.
